name: Louis-Philippe Baillargeon
headline: Unify People, Processes and Technology ♦ Propel Your Company Forward Using Technology ♦ 10X Certified NetSuite Consultant ♦ Services: NetSuite implementation, Optimization, Automation. Business Strategy
about:
Possible summary:

As the founder and CEO of StellarGrade, I combine my entrepreneurial spirit, techno-functional acumen, and NetSuite expertise to deliver proactive and customized solutions for my clients. I hold eight NetSuite certifications and a B.B.A. Mention of Excellence from HEC Montréal, with additional studies at Singapore Management University and Université de Montréal.

My team and I help businesses streamline their operations, automate their processes, and develop business applications that leverage NetSuite's full potential. We value trust, integrity, and collaboration, and we partner with our clients every step of the way to ensure their growth and success. We have worked with clients across various industries, including media, finance, and e-commerce, and have received positive feedback and referrals for our work.
… more

experiences.description:
From a young age, I have been driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, which led me to embark on a freelance career and eventually establish my business.

Over the years, with the growth of our team and our commitment to excellence, StellarGrade has become a thriving entity in our field. Our professional certifications, coupled with the extensive qualifications of our team, represent just a fraction of our success at StellarGrade.

We prioritize trust, integrity, and cooperation, and we are dedicated to aligning your growth with the right direction for your business.
I was a functional consultant in what was then North America's biggest NetSuite implementation. This project was for an American mass media corporation.
